name: jm-company-formation
description: How to form a company or register a business name in Jamaica in 2026, at the Companies Office of Jamaica (COJ), and register it with Tax Administration Jamaica. Gives the COJ fees (J$27,500 incorporation package with the Business Registration Form, stamp duty and beneficial ownership form; J$2,500 sole trader or small partnership; expedition J$3,000 or J$6,000), the annual return on the anniversary of incorporation (J$5,000, late fees up to J$10,000), and the post-incorporation TRN, GCT, NIS, NHT and HEART registrations. Trigger on Jamaica company formation, incorporate in Jamaica, COJ, BRF, annual return Jamaica, business name Jamaica. Built from COJ and TAJ pages; not reviewed by an accountant.
